entries.evidence: The four event-model objects now use ClockedObject cycle conversion; the default 1 GHz R1 exit tick and all functional/trace artifacts remain byte-exact. The isolated dual-clock rebase profile maps tile=500 MHz and system/AXI=250 MHz, but its re-scaled memory delays are explicitly not RTL measurements.

A 500 MHz tile-origin task_epilogue reached the 250 MHz Scheduler at a half-AXI-cycle phase in the dual-clock diagnostic run. stepEvent now uses clockEdge(cycles): all 14 scheduler-owned R1 trace events lie on 4 ns edges while task_epilogue remains a tile-domain event. This is not an RTL CDC or AXI-DMA timing proof.
